newsitem.title: POLAND: German Reemtsma builds new Polish cigarette plant.
newsitem.headline: German Reemtsma builds new Polish cigarette plant.

text.p: German tobacco company Reemtsma GmbH, which controls Polish tobacco firm WWT SA, said on Thursday it launched the construction of a new cigarette plant worth 180 million zlotys.

It said in a statement the factory, based in Jankowice, near the western city of Poznan, would produce 15 billion cigarettes annually and employ 750 workers and would be the biggest German investment in a green-field project in Poland.
Reemtsma's WWT Poznan SA will produce 10 billion cigarettes annually, once the new plant is opened. WWT output is forecast at 24.5 billion cigarettes in 1996. @
WWT, whose 76 percent shares Reemtsma bought in February for $130 million and so far has invested $45 million, has a 27-percent market share in Poland.
Its main competitors on the Polish market are Philip Morris,, R.J. Reynolds Tobacco Co, French Seita and British American Tobacco Industries Plc ).
